notes.title: Demo Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]We've added some fixes to the demo for Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road. [/p][p]Let us know if there's anything we've missed. It's all detailed in the patch notes below. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed joystick dead zone[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input issue that forces the hero to move right when using some specific devices or virtual controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hero death screen (gets stuck when the hero dies after beating the boss)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed possible blocker when closing the pause menu while the warning pop-up is visible [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed softlock when hero dies and levels up at the same time [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed locked camera for the next run after killing the boss while the city is dying [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed disabled 'next button' on end screen which blocks the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please do consider leaving us a review if you've enjoyed your time with the game or if this has fixed any issues you've had while playing.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all your support[/p][p][/p][p]Ludogram and Raw Fury[/p]
